interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and crossing locations.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Green Infrastructure Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological barrier between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with high-visibility paint to provide a designated crossing point for residents.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to maintain lower vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repair or replace cracked and uneven sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or a small buffer zone to provide physical separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a formal pedestrian refuge island in the center median area to allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove weeds to provide a level, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: If space permits, adding a small planting strip or furniture zone would provide a buffer from traffic and a designated place for trash bins.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing/Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width or number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway entrance to prioritize pedestrians and force vehicles to slow down.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Add street trees within a furniture zone or curb extensions to provide shade, improve the walking environment, and naturally slow vehicle speeds through psychological narrowing.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Parking Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near crossing points to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground the utilities to provide a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Buffer
interventions.description: Install a line of street trees or a planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Incorporate windows, murals, or architectural details into the blank wall to improve the pedestrian experience and increase natural surveillance.
